## [1.29.0](https://github.com/kondratjev/morphe-patches/compare/v1.28.2...v1.29.0) (2026-11-13)

### ✨ New Features

* **pillo:** allow editing paused medications ([2365132](https://github.com/kondratjev/morphe-patches/commit/236513286609ddc74001170454471e08fa8445ba))
* **scripts:** add apkget mirrors, enforce ABI, prune old APKs ([87d4802](https://github.com/kondratjev/morphe-patches/commit/87d480258b4e4a53f806c7c008db68b8f838bef0))

### 🚀 Updated App Support

* **fatsecret:** update to 11.10.0.3 ([b434587](https://github.com/kondratjev/morphe-patches/commit/b434587cb86974a3216e09684aea6573be0c5ffa))
* **pillo:** update to 0.6.28 ([ccbcfc5](https://github.com/kondratjev/morphe-patches/commit/ccbcfc5021ed6fa8b3ae11d6009f7444683cb2f9))

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks all Muscle Motion Strength Training Pro/Individual/Business features.

patches.name: Disable community tab
patches.description: Hides the News/Community tab from the bottom navigation.

patches.name: Disable force update dialog
patches.description: Makes the 'App must update' dialog skippable.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks all FatSecret Gold features and hides the Premium tab.

patches.name: Support patched YouTube Music
patches.description: Points the workout music button at a patched YouTube Music app instead of the stock package, so the button opens it.

options.description: Package name of the patched YouTube Music app installed on the device.

patches.name: Disable consent popup
patches.description: Disables the OneTrust consent/cookies popup on first launch.

patches.name: Edit paused medications
patches.description: Allows editing paused medications without resuming them first.

patches.name: MicroG support
patches.description: Fixes Google sign-in and sync on patched builds: routes Google services through MicroG-RE and reports the original certificate to Firebase. Requires MicroG-RE with a Google account.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks premium features and removes ads.
